name: GADANG
recent: Gadang Holdings Berhad 于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行第 33 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均以投票方式通过。公司于 10 月 21 日发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度的业绩，营收环比下降 5.2%，同比下降 48.9%，但录得净利 287.6 万令吉。此外，一名主要子公司董事在闭门交易期内外多次申报买卖公司股份。
notable: 第 33 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行，所有普通决议案均获通过。
截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度录得净利 287.6 万令吉，营收 1.1479 亿令吉。
一名主要子公司董事在 2026 年 10 月多次申报增持公司股份。
risks: 营收同比大幅下降 48.9%，环比下降 5.2%。
一名主要子公司董事在闭门交易期内多次交易公司股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度，营收为 1.1479 亿令吉，环比下降 5.2%，同比下降 48.9%；净利为 287.6 万令吉，净利率 2.5%，较上一季度的 -50.8% 有所改善。

recent_en: Gadang Holdings Berhad held its 33rd Annual General Meeting on 4 November 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were passed by poll. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026 on 21 October, with revenue down 5.2% QoQ and 48.9% YoY, but recorded a net profit of RM2.876 million. Separately, a director of a major subsidiary reported several dealings in the company's shares during and outside the closed period.
notable_en: The 33rd AGM was held on 4 November 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were passed.
Recorded a net profit of RM2.876 million on revenue of RM114.79 million for the quarter ended 31 August 2026.
A director of a major subsidiary reported multiple acquisitions of the company's shares in October 2026.
risks_en: Revenue declined significantly by 48.9% YoY and 5.2% QoQ.
A director of a major subsidiary traded the company's shares multiple times during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM114.79 million, down 5.2% QoQ and 48.9% YoY; net profit was RM2.876 million with a net margin of 2.5%, improving from -50.8% in the previous quarter.
